inputs.text: {"high_level_description": "Empty Bloodridge sunken crypt battle stage, rendered entirely in crisp, deliberately clustered pixel art. Bright storybook fantasy strategy game look in the spirit of Kingdom Rush: cheerful saturated colours, bold clean readable shapes, chunky pixel clusters, soft cartoon shading, sunny daylight under a clear blue sky with a few white clouds, spooky but cheerful.", "style_description": {"medium": "pixel_art", "art_style": "Authentic hand pixelled 2D game battle stage background. Visible square pixel clusters and stair stepped contours everywhere. Flat colour clusters, two to four shades per material. Crisp pixel edges without antialiasing. Clean readable shapes. No paint brushwork, no gradients except a dithered sky, no noise texture.", "aesthetics": "bright storybook fantasy strategy game stage, cheerful, saturated, bold readable shapes", "lighting": "Sunny midday light from the upper left as discrete flat pixel colour planes, soft cartoon shadows, the grass arena evenly lit and calm.", "color_palette": ["#2c5a30", "#4f9a3e", "#7ab84e", "#a8d46a", "#e8cc96", "#b48a62", "#6e5240", "#5aa6e4", "#b0daf0", "#ffffff", "#3a2834"]}, "compositional_deconstruction": {"background": "One continuous 2.5D battle stage seen from a fixed side oblique camera like a classic arcade game stage, no figures, no text. The top third is sky over a distant ridge. Along the back stands a row of ruins: an obelisk at the far left, a broken colonnade, the temple crypt in the middle with a brazier each side of its doorway, a ruined hut with ladders, a huge tree at the right, with coffins, a cart of skulls and pots in front of them. The lower two thirds is one wide open flat arena floor where two armies will stand, calm and even. A fallen column and a giant fallen statue head frame the bottom corners in shadow.", "elements": [{"type": "obj", "bbox": [0, 0, 420, 105], "desc": "a tall leaning sandstone obelisk with ivy"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [130, 55, 410, 325], "desc": "a broken sandstone colonnade with a red cloth banner and flowers"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [0, 370, 430, 635], "desc": "a cheerful ruined sandstone temple crypt with a dark doorway and two burning braziers"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [140, 600, 420, 860], "desc": "a ruined stone hut with wooden ladders"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [0, 790, 420, 1000], "desc": "a huge round leafy green tree"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [300, 250, 470, 1000], "desc": "old coffins, a cart full of cartoon skulls, clay pots and crates"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [0, 0, 330, 1000], "desc": "a bright blue sky with white clouds over soft green hills and a small stepped pyramid"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [420, 60, 1000, 940], "desc": "a calm green meadow arena of short even grass"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [820, 0, 1000, 230], "desc": "a mossy fallen column and stones"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [800, 830, 1000, 1000], "desc": "a big stone pharaoh head lying in the grass"}]}}
